frame_contract.sampling_scope: This fixed fresh frame only. A bounded cursor window is not automatically a probability sample. No population accuracy or probability error estimate is certified.

scoring_contract.unknown_reference: Exclude from truth comparisons but retain in full denominator for known-reference coverage. Reference is an independent machine, not truth.
scoring_contract.unknown_candidate: Retain as abstention against known reference, including recall false negatives. Missing and engineering-invalid are separately counted, not relabeled reviewed unknown.
scoring_contract.not_mentioned: Full-document review completed and no expression of this precise measure was found; never employer reality or explicit denial.
scoring_contract.explicit_negative: Represented experience explicitly_waived claims and entry explicit_no_experience are separate supported measures; never erase them into absence. Other negation concepts not encoded in Formal800 are not inferred.
scoring_contract.partial_reading: Retain source positives with partial status; no complete inventory or nonmention qualification.
scoring_contract.primary_binary_metrics: Positive precision, positive recall and two-class macro F1; candidate unknown contributes false negatives. Fixed support and reference coverage gates apply separately to every measure.
scoring_contract.structured_measures: Also require source-unit-supported atom precision >= .90, recall >= .80 and micro F1 >= .85. This extra conservative claim gate is separate from the binary macro F1.
scoring_contract.source_units: Deterministic line or sentence/semicolon units in field_score.source_units, Unicode offsets; precomputed SHA-bound input inventory.
scoring_contract.evidence: Unchanged validator checks each exact quote exists and retains all occurrences. Primary structured claims need equal represented values and at least one shared frozen source unit, with maximum one-to-one matching. No fuzzy quote repair.
scoring_contract.quote_boundaries: Exact source span agreement is diagnostic only. Different valid boundaries within the same support unit do not fail the primary score.
scoring_contract.source_unit_limitation: Coarse unit support does not identify named concepts within a sentence or prove interpretation. A long or repeated quote can map to several units; all mappings are retained and no unique span is claimed.
scoring_contract.group_relations: Ignore arbitrary group/branch IDs, branch order and condition display prose. Preserve OR versus AND, all declared branches, branch/shared membership, represented clause values, and branch/clause evidence support with one-to-one branch matching. No semantic parse of degree/condition prose.
scoring_contract.predeclared_unresolved: Unresolved components lower measure-specific reference coverage. Independent represented measures remain eligible for scoring.

reference_and_adjudication.primary_score_reference: Original independent Kimi; immutable, including unknowns and failures.
reference_and_adjudication.astra_selection: After frozen primary scoring, take at most six cases with known semantic disagreement or reviewed/unresolved semantic reference unknown, in ascending digest_json([protocol version, record_id, context_sha256]) order. Missing/transport/engineering failures alone do not trigger Astra. Ties break by record_id. No hand-picking outcomes.
reference_and_adjudication.astra_context: Same complete frozen input and unchanged schema/instructions; blind to candidate and reference labels.
reference_and_adjudication.astra_effect: Separate bounded diagnostic adjudication, never overwrite Kimi or tune the primary confirmation gate. Unresolved disputes stay unresolved.

operational_handoff.cases_jsonl: record_id, context_sha256, packet (original exact Formal800 packet including assignment), candidate and reference (original unchanged Formal800 objects or null), optional candidate_processing_status/reference_processing_status/protection_blocked.
operational_handoff.frame_freeze_json: frame_sha256, protocol_bundle_sha256 (file SHA of PROTOCOL_FREEZE.json), frozen_before_first_request=true; external runner provides trustworthy time/order/freshness/blindness evidence.
operational_handoff.protected_handling: Resolve protection membership before loading original packet/review files. A post-freeze quarantine row must contain metadata only and keeps its slot; scorer checks protection_blocked before packet/review access.
operational_handoff.production: Scorer reports eligible measure dependencies only; external bounded runtime checks authorization, identity, versions, nonduplicate queue, budgets and participating dependencies. No later input admitted merely because one unrelated field passes.
